-- The TARGET is these definitions, which also appear in the context: D25, d26
def S1.D25 {X Y : Type} (N : S1 X Y) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, Finite (N.A3 n) ∧ Nat.card (N.A3 n) ≤ k

def d26 (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] : S1 Bool Bool where
  A1 := Unit
  a2 := inferInstance
  A3 := fun _ => Fin m
  a4 := fun _ => 0
  a5 := fun _ σ x => if x then σ () + 1 else σ ()
  a6 := fun σ => decide (σ () = 0)
